Auktika
alaṅk. by Uktigarbha; ref. to in Rājaśekhara's Kāvyamīmāṁsā GOS. I. p. 1. See also NCC. II. p. 281a.

Auktika
gr. Baroda 2071 (Saṁ. 1663). 4129 (different from Udayadharma's an. Kulamaṇḍana's work). BORI. 797 of 1899-1915. BP. p. 187a. Chani 3480. 3579 (with C.). JBhP. I. 431. See below.

Auktika
or vAkyaprakAza Jain. a metrical manual of Skt. gr. in 129 verses divided into 7 sections. Composed in 1451 A. D. by Udayadharma, pupil of Ratnasiṁha, of Tapāgaccha (a. called Dharmasūri in some mss.).
B. III. 18. Baroda 2205, 2895. 5281. Bomb. Uni. 81 (with C.). BP. p.. 164b (called Uktivākyaº). 203a. 229b. 240b. 249a. 250b. 251. 252b. 253a (2 mss.). 254a (2 mss.). BORI. 415 of 1871-72. 280 of 1873-74 (with C.). 763 of 1875-76. 1370 of 1884-87. (a. called Dharmasūri). 531 of 1886-92 (with C.). 229 an. 230 of 1892-95. Brahmacāri Wāḍi 61. 62. Br. Mus. 383. 384 (with C.). Cabaton I. 633 (iii). Chani 657. 664. 3350 (with C.). CPB. 7869-7871. D. p.. 40. 68. 117. Fl. 189. Firenze 455 (a. called Dharmasūri). Gough p. 99. Gu. 11. Jainagranthāvalī p. 307. JASB. 1908. [Page097-b] p. 431a (no. 7429) (a. called Dharmasūri). JBhP. I. 2311. 2312 (with C.). Kh. p. 103. Lz. 182 (with C.). Peters. IV. p. 19 (no. 531). V. p. 243 (no. 229.) Rep. Raj. & C. I. p. 44. Ujjain I. p. 84 (a. called Udayasiṁha).
--C. Baroda 2205 (d. Saṁ. 1783). BORI. 531 of 1886-92. BP. p. 254a. Br. Mus. 384. CPB. 7869-71 (one of the mss.). Fl. 189. JBhP. I. 2312. Lz. 782. Peters. IV. p. 19 (no. 531).
--C. Avacūri. BORI. 280 of 1873-74. D. p. 68. Kh. p. 103 (no. 280).
--C. Ṭīkā. Br. Mus. 384. Chani 3350.
--C. Vākyaprakāśavārttā by Jinavijaya, pupil of Kīrtivijaya, composed in Saṁ. 1694 (1637 A. D.). Br. Mus. 383. CPB. 7869-7871 (only one of the mss.).
--C. by Harṣakulagaṇi, pupil of Hemavimalasūri (who wrote in A. D. 1527 his Dīpikā, C. on Sūtrakṛtāṅgasūtra. See BBRAS. 1550-2). B. III. 18. Bomb. Uni. 81. BORI. 230 of 1892-95. Brahmacāri Wāḍi 61. Peters. V. p. 243 (no. 230).

Auktika
or mugdhabAlAvabodha Jain. gr. by Kulamaṇḍanasūri; composed in 1506 A. D. Baroda 4685. 13931 (called Auktikasaṅgraha). Jainagranthāvalī p. 306.

Auktika
Jain. gr. by Jinacandra. Jainagranthāvalī p. 306.

Auktika
gr. (by Tilakācārya ?). Baroda 2190. in Skt. an. Gujarati. See also Uktisaṅgraha of Tilaka, NCC. II. p. 281b.

Auktika
Jain. gr. by Somaprabha. Jainagranthāvalī p. 306.
